prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Companion Journey"]
1: []
2: ["Calibrate Pet Temperament", "Set how active, quiet, or playful your desktop pet will act on your screen.", "Select Temperament Profile"]
3: ["Play Spawntime Game"]
4: ["Sign in with your original social or email account to retain existing pets. New logins create fresh accounts.", "Account Tip: Re-use your primary sign-in to restore saved desktop pets."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate Sealed", "Name your desktop pet"]
6: ["Play Audio Notification When Pet Spawns", "Your pet will automatically anchor to your system taskbar once loading completes."]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion!", "Interact with your pet on the desktop now to earn your First Friend Achievement Badge.", "First Friend Badge Ready"]
8: ["Interactive path includes mini-games; Passive path runs lightweight in the taskbar background.", "Passive path uses low system resources. Interactive path unlocks direct desktop chatter."]
9: ["Controls: Drag to move, right-click to hide/open settings, double-click to chat.", "Try Controls Now"]
